description: Shape key (blend shape) standard. Facial shapes live on the {character}_face mesh; corrective shapes live on the mesh they correct. Names are exported unchanged through glTF and addressed by name in Godot. 'tier' is the lowest character tier that REQUIRES the shape: normal < s < splus.

shapes.name: eye_blink_L
shapes.desc: Full close, upper lid meets lower lid on the lash line. Lashes must not intersect.

shapes.name: eye_blink_R
shapes.desc: Mirror of eye_blink_L.

shapes.name: eye_smile_L
shapes.desc: Anime happy-closed arc (lower lid rises, upper lid curves down).

shapes.name: eye_wide_L
shapes.desc: Surprise / shock. Upper lid lifts clear of the iris top.

shapes.name: eye_narrow_L
shapes.desc: Focus squint. Upper lid lowers onto the iris, lower lid lifts slightly. Must stay readable, never looks sleepy.

shapes.name: eye_lid_heavy_L
shapes.desc: Upper lid only, relaxed-cool half lid. Distinct from narrow (no lower-lid lift).

shapes.name: brow_down_L
shapes.desc: Whole brow lowers and angles toward the nose (determination).

shapes.name: brow_inner_up
shapes.desc: Worry / sadness. Inner ends lift.

shapes.name: brow_angry
shapes.desc: Inner ends drop hard, slight crease.

shapes.name: mouth_A
shapes.desc: Vowel A, jaw open. Lip-sync and shout base.

shapes.name: mouth_I
shapes.desc: Vowel I, wide, teeth visible.

shapes.name: mouth_U
shapes.desc: Vowel U, small round.

shapes.name: mouth_E
shapes.desc: Vowel E.

shapes.name: mouth_O
shapes.desc: Vowel O.

shapes.name: mouth_smile
shapes.desc: Closed smile.

shapes.name: mouth_grit
shapes.desc: Effort: lips apart, teeth clenched.

shapes.name: mouth_shout
shapes.desc: Spike yell: square open, upper teeth visible, cheeks lifted.

shapes.name: mouth_exhale
shapes.desc: Small parted 'o' of a controlled breath. Signature focus mouth for calm characters.

shapes.name: mouth_smirk_L
shapes.desc: One-sided smile.

shapes.name: cheek_raise
shapes.desc: Cheeks push up (real smiles, shouts). Supports eye_smile.

shader_driven.note: These facial signals are shader parameters, NOT shape keys, so they cost no vertex work and animate per frame cheaply.

params.name: gaze_offset
params.desc: Iris/pupil offset in eye UV space. Driven by the face controller's look-at.

params.name: eye_glow
params.desc: Iris emissive lift for S+ close-ups.

params.name: blush
params.desc: Cheek/nose blush intensity from the blush mask.

params.name: face_shadow_soft
params.desc: SDF face-shadow edge softness per lighting context.

expression_presets.note: Global presets. Characters may override or add presets in character.json. Weights 0..1. Mirrored shapes may be written without side as a shorthand: 'eye_narrow' sets both _L and _R.

correctives.note: Corrective shapes are driven by the angle between two bone SEGMENTS (bone origin to child origin). This is axis-convention independent, so Blender drivers and the Godot corrective driver compute the same value. weight = remap(angle, from_deg, to_deg, 0, 1), clamped.

shapes.name: corr_knee_L
shapes.desc: Keeps knee volume, prevents candy-wrapper collapse at the back of the knee.

shapes.name: corr_shoulder_up_L
shapes.desc: Arm overhead (spike, block, set). Deltoid bunches, armpit keeps shape.

shapes.name: corr_hip_flex_L
shapes.desc: Crouch / receive stance. Groin crease and glute stretch.

shapes.name: corr_kneepad_L
shapes.desc: Pad front stays rigid, back sleeve compresses.
